name: repopulse-alexa-plus
title: RepoPulse AI • Alexa+ Maintainer & Cloud FinOps Skill
description: Voice-enabled open-source code maintainer, AWS Well-Architected security auditor, and cloud cost-delta estimator for Alexa+ conversational agents.

tools.name: review_pull_request_diff
tools.description: Reviews a git diff using Amazon Nova Pro reasoning, detecting AST regressions and breaking changes.
voiceExamples: Alexa, ask RepoPulse to review the latest pull request
Alexa, what does Amazon Nova think of our latest PR diff?

tools.name: aws_audit_iac
tools.description: Scans AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform diffs for wildcard IAM policies, exposed security groups, and encryption gaps.

fileContent.description: Raw CDK or CloudFormation template content

voiceExamples: Alexa, ask RepoPulse: are there any security issues in my AWS CDK stack?
Alexa, run an AWS Well-Architected audit on my latest commit

tools.name: estimate_aws_cost_delta
tools.description: Calculates projected monthly and annual AWS spend impact for newly added or deleted infrastructure with Graviton optimization tips.
voiceExamples: Alexa, ask RepoPulse: how much will this PR change our AWS bill?
Alexa, what is the estimated cloud cost delta for our staging infrastructure?

tools.name: apply_bedrock_guardrail
tools.description: Scans code, comments, or issues for leaked AWS access keys, credentials, PII, and adversarial prompt injections.

text.description: Text or code to evaluate through guardrail policies

voiceExamples: Alexa, ask RepoPulse if there are any leaked AWS keys in the latest commit
Alexa, verify if this contributor PR passed Bedrock Guardrails
